claims: Luke Combs kicks off his "My Kinda Saturday Night World Tour" at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas on Saturday, March 21, 2026.
The concert has an expected crowd of 70,000.
The concert features Dierks Bentley, Ty Myers, and Thelma & James.
Luke Combs is expected around 9 p.m.
The event enforces a strict clear bag policy with maximum size 12" x 6" x 12".
The National Weather Service has issued an extreme heat warning for the area.
Luke Combs is opening a country bar named "Category 10" on the Las Vegas Strip.
